**NET-TOOLS 0.6.0**: 26 new network tools — 151 in total — plus a real HTTP/3 request with 0-RTT test and an AS path / route map for traceroutes.

## New tools

- **IP & addressing**: IPv6 address analyzer, IP address plan (IPAM sheet, IPv4/IPv6), NAT64 / DNS64 check, country IP blocks (prefix-list, ipset, MikroTik output).
- **DNS**: open resolver test (with amplification factor), reverse DNS coverage (FCrDNS for a /24), HTTPS / SVCB & ECH viewer, EDNS compliance test.
- **HTTP & web**: CDN & WAF detector, cache header analyzer, mixed content checker, CSP builder & evaluator.
- **TLS**: DANE / TLSA checker, certificate chain validator (fetches missing intermediates), PKCS#12 / PFX inspector and lab CA & certificate generator (both entirely in the browser).
- **Email**: SMTP banner & FCrDNS check.
- **BGP**: route history & visibility, ASN neighbour graph, ROA coverage per ASN, common IXPs & facilities.
- **Calculators**: SLA & uptime, VoIP bandwidth & Erlang B, packet decoder, pcap viewer (in the browser).
- **Client**: DNS hijack & proxy check.

## Improvements

- HTTP/2 & HTTP/3 check: a real HTTP/3 request, time to first byte compared with TCP, session resumption and 0-RTT.
- Traceroute / MTR: AS path, and the route on a world map when geolocation is available (local GeoIP database or ipinfo key).

## Upgrade

```bash
cd net-tools-docker
git pull
docker compose pull && docker compose up -d
```

No configuration changes are required. If `NETTOOLS_VERSION` is pinned in `.env`, set it to `0.6.0`.

Images: `ghcr.io/digibaro/nettools-web:0.6.0`, `ghcr.io/digibaro/nettools-api:0.6.0` (amd64 + arm64, SBOM and provenance). Full list: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/digibaro/net-tools-docker/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

## Notes

- node-forge (used by the PKCS#12 inspector) has an open advisory (GHSA-86w9-cpqp-85rv) without a fix; the affected RSA signature check is not used. See `docs/SECURITY.md`.
- Not yet included: browser TLS fingerprint, UDP service probe, IPsec/IKE probe.
